preview: A plain-language record of what a client may do with your images: which pictures, where, for how long and for what fee.
alt: An embossed seal on a certificate
contents: Parties: who owns the images and who is licensing them
Licensed images: the files this covers
Terms: media, territory, dates, fee and credit
Licence: the wording both sides sign

faq.a: It's a starting point that records what was agreed. For high-value or exclusive work, have a lawyer check the wording before anyone signs.

sections.title: Licence
sections.default:
[Photographer] grants [Client] a licence to use the images listed above for the usage, in the territory and for the dates set out in the terms above.

The images stay the property of [Photographer]. They may not be resold, passed to anyone else, or changed beyond normal retouching without written permission. Any use outside these terms needs a new licence.

Where a credit line is given above, it appears wherever the images run.

Signed, [Photographer]:

Signed, [Client]:
